content: Backend-only RLS pattern: run each request in a transaction that does select set_config('request.jwt.claims', <json>, true) and SET LOCAL ROLE authenticated so Supabase auth.uid()/auth.jwt() helpers and tenant policies apply; never use service_role/postgres superuser for tenant queries; with Supavisor transaction pooler set prepare:false in postgres-js; a simpler app.tenant_id GUC with policies comparing tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id') is the classic multi-tenant SaaS pattern.
